headline: Innovaccer Named a Leader in the Inaugural Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Healthcare Provider Industry Cloud Platforms
summary: SAN FRANCISCO, July 29, 2026--Innovaccer, the autonomous operations platform for healthcare, today announced it has been named a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Healthcare Provider Industry Cloud Platforms.
